class Solution:
    def addTwoNumbers(self, l1, l2, carry=0):
        if not l1 and not l2 and not carry: return None
        s = (l1.val if l1 else 0) + (l2.val if l2 else 0) + carry
        node = ListNode(s % 10)
        node.next = self.addTwoNumbers(l1.next if l1 else None, l2.next if l2 else None, s // 10)
        return node

    def removeNthFromEnd(self, head, n):
        dummy = ListNode(0, head); size = 0; cur = head
        while cur: size += 1; cur = cur.next

class Solution:
    def strStr(self, haystack, needle):
        if not needle: return 0
        lps = [0] * len(needle); k = 0
        for i in range(1, len(needle)):
            while k and needle[i] != needle[k]: k = lps[k - 1]
            if needle[i] == needle[k]: k += 1
            lps[i] = k
        k = 0
        for i, c in enumerate(haystack):
            while k and c != needle[k]: k = lps[k - 1]
            if c == needle[k]: k += 1
            if k == len(needle): return i - k + 1
        return -1

class Solution:
    def search(self, nums, target):
        lo, hi = 0, len(nums) - 1
        while lo < hi:
            mid = (lo + hi) // 2
            if nums[mid] > nums[hi]: lo = mid + 1
            else: hi = mid
        pivot = lo; n = len(nums); lo, hi = 0, n - 1
        while lo <= hi:
            mid = (lo + hi) // 2; real = (mid + pivot) % n
            if nums[real] == target: return real
            if nums[real] < target: lo = mid + 1
            else: hi = mid - 1
        return -1

class Solution:
    def rotateRight(self, head, k):
        if not head or not head.next: return head
        n, tail = 1, head
        while tail.next: tail = tail.next; n += 1
        k %= n
        if k == 0: return head
        new_tail = head
        for _ in range(n - k - 1): new_tail = new_tail.next
        new_head = new_tail.next
        new_tail.next = None; tail.next = head
        return new_head

class Solution:
    def rotateRight(self, head, k):
        if not head or not head.next or k == 0: return head
        n, cur = 0, head
        while cur: n += 1; cur = cur.next
        k %= n
        if k == 0: return head
        fast = slow = head
        for _ in range(k): fast = fast.next
        while fast.next: fast = fast.next; slow = slow.next
        new = slow.next; slow.next = None; fast.next = head
        return new

class Solution:
    def searchMatrix(self, matrix, target):
        m, n = len(matrix), len(matrix[0])
        lo, hi = 0, m * n - 1
        while lo <= hi:
            mid = (lo + hi) // 2
            v = matrix[mid // n][mid % n]
            if v == target: return True
            if v < target: lo = mid + 1
            else: hi = mid - 1
        return False

class Solution:
    def partition(self, head, x):
        vals, cur = [], head
        while cur: vals.append(cur.val); cur = cur.next
        vals = [v for v in vals if v < x] + [v for v in vals if v >= x]
        dummy = cur = ListNode()

class Solution:
    def reverseBetween(self, head, left, right):
        dummy = ListNode(0, head); prev = dummy
        for _ in range(left - 1): prev = prev.next
        cur = prev.next
        for _ in range(right - left):
            nxt = cur.next
            cur.next = nxt.next
            nxt.next = prev.next
            prev.next = nxt
        return dummy.next

class Solution:
    def reverseBetween(self, head, left, right):
        vals, cur = [], head
        while cur: vals.append(cur.val); cur = cur.next
        vals[left - 1:right] = vals[left - 1:right][::-1]
        cur = head
        for v in vals: cur.val = v; cur = cur.next
        return head

class Solution:
    def reverseBits(self, n):
        n = (n >> 16) | ((n << 16) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
        n = ((n & 0xFF00FF00) >> 8) | ((n & 0x00FF00FF) << 8)
        n = ((n & 0xF0F0F0F0) >> 4) | ((n & 0x0F0F0F0F) << 4)
        n = ((n & 0xCCCCCCCC) >> 2) | ((n & 0x33333333) << 2)
        n = ((n & 0xAAAAAAAA) >> 1) | ((n & 0x55555555) << 1)
        return n

class Solution:
    def productExceptSelf(self, nums):
        n = len(nums)
        L, R, answer = [0]*n, [0]*n, [0]*n
        L[0] = 1
        for i in range(1,n): L[i] = nums[i-1]*L[i-1]
        R[n-1] = 1
        for i in reversed(range(n-1)): R[i] = nums[i+1]*R[i+1]
        for i in range(n): answer[i] = L[i]*R[i]
        return answer

class Solution:
    def longestZigZag(self, root):
        best = 0
        def dfs(node, came_from, length):
            nonlocal best
            if not node: return
            best = max(best, length)
            dfs(node.left, 'L', length + 1 if came_from == 'R' else 1)
            dfs(node.right, 'R', length + 1 if came_from == 'L' else 1)
        dfs(root, '', 0)
        return best

class Solution:
    def longestZigZag(self, root):
        best = 0
        def go(n):
            nonlocal best
            if not n: return -1, -1
            l = go(n.left)[1] + 1
            r = go(n.right)[0] + 1
            best = max(best, l, r)
            return l, r
        go(root)
        return best

class Solution:
    def deleteMiddle(self, head):
        n, cur = 0, head
        while cur: n += 1; cur = cur.next
        if n == 1: return None
        cur = head
        for _ in range(n // 2 - 1): cur = cur.next
        cur.next = cur.next.next
        return head

class Solution:
    def deleteMiddle(self, head):
        vals, cur = [], head
        while cur: vals.append(cur.val); cur = cur.next
        vals.pop(len(vals) // 2)
        dummy = cur = ListNode()
        for v in vals: cur.next = ListNode(v); cur = cur.next
        return dummy.next
